card.name: Just before body or physical in body-and-mind phrases
card.fires_on: Small words like both, a comma, a dash, of or the, right before the word body or physical in phrases pairing body with mind or spirit. Also fires on body itself when mind comes next.

modes.label: Both before body/physically
modes.description: The word both opens a pairing of body and mind.
modes.example: There's plenty of evidence that exercise is good for<< both>> body and mind.

modes.label: List separators
modes.description: A comma or dash in a list like heart, mind, body, soul.
modes.example: how to care for themselves<<—>>heart, mind, body, and soul

modes.label: Linking words before body
modes.description: Words like of, the, or have before body or spirit in discussions of the body versus the spirit.
modes.example: death marked the separation<< of>> the body from the spirit.

card.writes: It pushes the model to predict body or physical as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on the word just before body or physical when the text pairs body with mind or spirit.
